input.comment: [Playbook] Section 7 is headed "Indemnification of Contractor" but contains no indemnity language at all, leaving us with no protection against third-party IP claims. We insert a Contractor IP indemnity with the customary Company modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace and refund remedies, and a 3x annual fees super-cap that overrides the Section 7(a) fee cap, which is our fallback position.

ops.text: Contractor shall indemnify Company against any third-party claim alleging that the Services or the Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from (i) modification of the Works by Company, (ii) combination of the Works by Company with items not supplied by Contractor, or (iii) Contractor's compliance with specifications furnished by Company. Contractor shall, at its option, procure for Company the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of those remedies is reasonably available, refund the fees paid to Contractor for the affected item. Notwithstanding Section 7(a), Contractor's liability under this Section 7(d) shall not exceed three times (3x) the annual fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement.
